name: Nosferatu Thrall
source: Pathfinder Monster Core 2, Vampire, Nosferatu (pg. 338), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=630
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Monster Core 2 is ORC licensed material.
rules: For a non-mindless living creature that isn't immune to mental effects, bound to a nosferatu by a 1-day ritual. Increase its level by 1. Gains fast healing 5, weakness 10 to mental damage, Mindbound, Mortal Shield and Rally.
optional: A nosferatu can keep as many thralls as its Charisma modifier; making more frees the earlier ones.

abilities.name: Mindbound
abilities.description: A nosferatu master exerts a fierce hold over their thrall's mind. If any creature other than {name}'s master targets them with an effect that would give them the controlled condition, {name}'s master rolls a counteract check against it using their Dominate DC – 10 as the counteract check modifier.

abilities.name: Mortal Shield
abilities.description: Trigger {Name}'s master would take damage from a Strike or spell attack and is in an adjacent square; Effect {Name} throws themself in front of their master, taking half the damage of the attack (before applying any weaknesses or resistances). {Name}'s master takes the remaining damage, applying any weaknesses or resistances as normal.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.description: Trigger {Name} ends their turn more than 30 feet away from their master; Effect {Name} Strides up to their Speed toward their master.
